notes: New: Announcement detail (Settings) controls how much TalkBack reads out for each station, channel, podcast, or episode row - Minimal/Standard/Detailed. Sound Upscaler (Sound Effects, formerly Aural Exciter) now combines treble sparkle and bass warmth into one switch, automatically scales its strength to how thin the current stream actually is, and switches on Clip Guard alongside it so the stronger combined boost stays clean.
